name: After § 5
title: Resolution on the case of Bülent Mumay in Türkiye
part_text: 5a. Calls on the Council to make the full implementation by Türkiye of its rule of law and fundamental rights obligations an integral part of EU-Türkiye relations; condemns, in this context, the fact that despite the continued erosion of democracy and the rule of law in Türkiye, the EU continues to fund the country to restrict the entry of refugees and migrants into the EU; reiterates that human rights should not be undermined by migration management, commercial interests or counter-terrorism actions;
